  • Constructor Details

    • State

      private State(FetkovichAquifer aquifer, double timeSeconds, double cumulativeInfluxM3, double pressureBara, double intervalInfluxM3, double intervalMinimumCumulativeInfluxM3, double intervalMaximumCumulativeInfluxM3)
      Freezes a validated state without exposing mutable aquifer ownership.
      Parameters:
      aquifer - immutable originating model
      timeSeconds - elapsed time in seconds
      cumulativeInfluxM3 - signed cumulative reservoir-volume influx in m3
      pressureBara - average aquifer pressure in bara
      intervalInfluxM3 - signed influx during the last interval in m3
      intervalMinimumCumulativeInfluxM3 - minimum signed cumulative influx throughout the last interval, m3
      intervalMaximumCumulativeInfluxM3 - maximum signed cumulative influx throughout the last interval, m3
